data.title: Thai Banks Bet on Blockchain to Make Carbon Credits Trusted
data.description: Tokenised mangrove credits and a global registry are moving from concept to pilot – but Veolia warns the hard part is still what happens on the ground

data.title: Spot gold gains 0.3% on September 18 as oil prices fall
data.description: Gold reached a one-week high in global trading and was on course for a first weekly gain in four weeks, despite a stronger US dollar

data.title: Thai spikers, teqball aces seal progress
data.description: The Thai women's volleyball team swept aside Taiwan 3-0 to cruise into the quarter-finals as Pool C winners, capping off a dominant run through the preliminary phase at the Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Gymnasium in Okazaki City, Aichi Prefecture, on Friday.

data.title: BG Pathum fight back to hold Sailors
data.description: BG Pathum United fought back to secure a 1-1 draw against Singapore's Lion City Sailors in their AFC Champions League Two Group F fixture on Thursday.

data.title: 'Pause' on overt repression in Venezuela, but reforms still needed: HRW
data.description: CARACAS - Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez has overseen a "pause" in the overt repression of opponents since taking office in January, Human Rights Watch (HRW) said Friday, 18 years after the organization was expelled from the country.

data.title: Trump claims 'infinite' Greenland security deal with Denmark
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said Friday that he had struck a deal with Denmark to give Washington "permanent control" over Greenland's security that would bar Russia and China from setting up bases in the Arctic territory.

data.title: UK scholar says 'even facts can mislead'
data.description: Accurate facts can be just as misleading as outright falsehoods when selectively presented or misinterpreted, says London Business School finance professor Alex Edmans.

data.title: Dental clinic warning issued
data.description: The Department of Health Service Support has urged patients to verify dental clinics and practitioners before seeking treatment, following the arrest of a woman accused of running an unlicensed dental service from her home in Ayutthaya.

data.title: Anutin preps coalition for censure test
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said he was in contact with coalition leaders and ministers and was preparing another dinner meeting to strengthen ties ahead of the upcoming censure debate.

data.title: Navy stands by frigate bidding
data.description: The Royal Thai Navy has come under public scrutiny after only one company, South Korea's Hanwha Ocean, was deemed qualified to take on the 17-billion-baht frigate procurement.

data.title: Recipients may get 1,000-baht boost
data.description: The government has indicated that the second phase of the Thais Help Thais Plus co-payment scheme is likely to provide a one-off 1,000-baht allowance, which can be used over two months.

data.title: Nigeria miners struggled to breathe in cell before 37 died: survivors
data.description: MINNA (NIGERIA) - Survivors of a Nigerian disaster that saw 37 suspected illegal gold miners die while in the custody of a paramilitary civil defence group recounted their panic on Friday as they struggled to breathe inside the cell.

data.title: Cuba hit with seventh major blackout of the year
data.description: HAVANA - Cuba was plunged into its seventh massive blackout of the year on Friday, the energy ministry said, as fuel shortages bite on the US-blockaded island.

data.title: Trump says CNN, MS NOW, Politico banned from White House
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said Friday he was banning news outlets CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House, accusing them without specifics of reporting "fiction and lies."

data.title: UN chief 'deeply regrets' US visa refusal to Abbas for annual meeting
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres "deeply regrets" Washington's decision to deny a visa for the second year running to Palestinian leader Mahmoud Abbas, a UN spokesman said Friday, preventing him for attending the UN General Assembly.

data.title: Thailand at heart of Miss Universe turmoil
data.description: Miss Universe Thailand and five of her Southeast Asian peers could be barred from competing in the Miss Universe 2026 pageant in November because of a bitter legal dispute over national franchise agreements.

data.title: Isolated Syrian-Druze city blames Damascus for shortages
data.description: SWEIDA (SYRIA) - In her bakery, Hoda Kiwan impatiently awaits flour and fuel, which have become scarce in southern Syria's Sweida, the Druze-majority city still outside Damascus' control.

data.title: Elderly couple in Buri Ram die hours apart after decades together
data.description: A story of enduring love between an elderly couple in Buri Ram has moved people online after the pair, married for decades, died within hours of each other. The husband, who passed away first, died just 10 minutes after his wife returned home from hospital — with their grandchildren saying he had likely been waiting for her.

data.title: Anti-Assad music star makes triumphant return to Syria
data.description: DAMASCUS - Syrian singer Assala Nasri has made a triumphant return to Damascus with a sold-out concert following 15 years of exile due to her opposition to ousted ruler Bashar al-Assad.

data.title: Thailand's separatists vow to fight to the end
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Two decades into an insurgency that has killed thousands in southern Thailand, a leader of the main separatist group vowed this week to keep fighting until they achieve their goals.

data.title: Your weekly horoscope for Sept 18-24
data.description: Your spot-on weekly horoscope for work, money and relationships from Guru by Bangkok Post 's famously accurate fortune teller. Let's see how you will fare this week and beyond.

data.title: Australian suspect in Pattaya teen's murder denied bail
data.description: The Australian suspect in the killing of a Thai girl was denied bail on Friday after refuting the allegation and other charges at the Pattaya Provincial Court.

data.title: Heirs of land donor press on with temple land challenge
data.description: KHON KAEN – Chommanee Noichan, widely known as “Aunt Da,” and an estate administrator reported to police on Friday to acknowledge charges in connection with a dispute over land donated to a forest temple in Muang district of this northeastern province.

data.title: TAT praises LISA after Thai food showcase on US talk show goes viral
data.description: TAT Governor Thapanee Kiatphaibool praised LISA for presenting Thai food and culture to a global audience during her appearance on Jimmy Fallon’s talk show.

data.title: Bomb, shooting attack on defence volunteer truck in Narathiwat
data.description: NARATHIWAT – An unknown number of assailants detonated a bomb and opened fire on a six-wheel truck carrying territorial defence voluneers in Sukhirin district of this southern border province on Friday afternoon. No injuries or deaths were reported.
